rows.note: Use 抵 as the all-purpose colloquial choice when something is worth doing or gives a fair return for the effort or cost.

example.english: This movie is so good that it’s worth paying a few dozen dollars for.
example.traditional: 呢套戲咁好睇，畀幾十蚊都抵。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 gam3 hou2 tai2 bei2 gei2 sap6 man1 dou1 dai2

rows.note: Use 值錢 when emphasizing that something has monetary or exchange value, rather than whether an action is worthwhile.

example.english: This old watch is still worth money, so we can take it to auction.
example.traditional: 呢隻舊手錶仲值錢，可以拎去拍賣。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 gau6 sau2 biu2 zung6 zik6 cin2 ho2 ji5 ling1 heoi3 paak3 maai6
